caption: The drawing is a black and white illustration of a balcony railing set against a plain, light-colored background. The railing features a rectangular frame with vertical bars evenly spaced across its length. The top rail has a decorative pattern of alternating circles and diagonal diamonds within a linear border. In the center of the railing is an ornate design containing two crossed cannons, a decorative element resembling a torch or flame at the top, and curved flourishes at the base. The floor beneath the railing is depicted with parallel lines indicating wooden planks. The entire image is bordered by a thin rectangular line with small square details in each corner. At the bottom center of the drawing, the words "Balcony Railing" are handwritten in a cursive script.
title: Cast Iron Balcony Rail
